policy.rule: Any model/tool/price/version claim used in a script is the value below, verified live against `source` on `retrieved`. Never recall these from model memory. refresh-facts.mjs flags a fact when it ages past max_age_days or its value no longer appears on `source`; a human/agent then re-confirms live and updates `value` + `retrieved` (the auditor never overwrites).

facts.subject: anthropic
facts.label: Anthropic flagship Claude model id (default for builds)
facts.notes: Opus 4.8 is the current most-capable AVAILABLE Claude model and the default for all builds. Claude Fable 5 was briefly the most-capable model but is SUSPENDED (unavailable for everyone) since 2026-06-12 — do not use it (see anthropic.fable-5.status).

facts.subject: anthropic
facts.label: Anthropic most-capable AVAILABLE model id
facts.notes: Opus 4.8 is the most-capable model anyone can actually use right now. Claude Fable 5 ranked higher but was suspended on 2026-06-12 (see anthropic.fable-5.status); revert this to claude-fable-5 only if/when access is restored.

facts.subject: anthropic
facts.label: Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 availability status
facts.notes: Launched GA 2026-06-09; Anthropic disabled BOTH models for everyone on 2026-06-12 (~3 days later) after a US government export-control directive that bars access by any foreign national (incl. Anthropic's own staff) and can't be filtered in real time. A government suspension, NOT a deprecation; other models (Opus 4.8 etc.) are unaffected. Trigger: Amazon CEO flagged a jailbreak/security report to the White House; 5+ firms piled on.
